I couldn't find a name for Kwame's night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor. I only checked what you can see: #coastal-team, the Coastal files and our DM.

The Coastal cheat sheet says engineering gave "the night dispatcher" at Driftmoor Marine Freight a manual CSV patch after the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. It doesn't say who that person is. Kwame is the one to ask.

If you email them, they're outside pemberline.com. Even a draft to them needs Ruth Calloway's approval. Once you have the name and address, tell me and I'll ask Ruth.
